text:
lina: Quick async — Halcyon onprem cutover is stalled. Net team needs CR approval for customer FW rules, and image sync to our air‑gap repo is failing with signature errors. Who owns what? cc @netops @marco

netops: We're blocked waiting on Change Request #9872 approval from security. ETA for approval: EOD tomorrow. Also need the customer to open 443 and 1025-1030 to the staging NAT.

raj: I can take the image sync once signed artifacts are available. Current push error is `403: signature mismatch`. @emma can you confirm whether signing key rotated?

emma: Confirmed — we rotated the prod signing key yesterday. Onprem manifests weren't updated with the new public key. Pushing a patch to `airgap-manifests` now, should be done in ~30m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: halcyon-staging-sync started at 2026-03-18T14:05Z — task id d4f8

marco: I can queue the firewall CR review today. I need exact CIDRs from the customer and a proof-of-life test plan before approval. @lina can you drop those? Also confirm whether egress must go via our proxy or direct NAT.

lina: Added CIDRs and smoke plan to the ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CR-9872 — test plan includes `curl` to S3 mirror + TLS validation. Egress should go through our egress-proxy for audit logging.

raj: Thanks. After emma's manifest update I'll run `./scripts/sync-airgap.sh halcyon` and paste logs here. If signature still fails I'll fall back to manual `scp` + md5/sha256 verification.

emma: Patch merged to `airgap-manifests`. Public key is at `s3://redwood-keys/halcyon.pub`. Note: HSM rotation is scheduled for next week — could impact other tenants if not coordinated.

ops-bot: image-sync: task d4f8 failed at 2026-03-18T14:27Z — error: unauthorized (signature verification) — retrying (1/3)

sre-oncall: Heads-up — if we enable direct egress for this tenant add an egress fallback policy in case the proxy flakes. I can own the fallback NAT rule during the cutover window.

marco: Customer just replied with CIDRs + signed LOA. I'll approve the CR once we verify manifest fingerprints. @raj — can you paste the sha256 output after the next sync attempt?

raj: sha256:3b2a1f9c7d2e9a4b5c6f8d0e1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678 (full hash in ticket). If I have to scp fallback I'll tag the commit `onprem:manual-sync`.

lina: :thumbsup: Plan recap — 1) emma applied the key patch; 2) raj runs sync and posts hashes; 3) marco approves CR; 4) sre-oncall creates egress fallback; 5) deploy-bot will kick a canary. Target cutover window: TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Please ping if anything blocks.

emma: FYI the airgap registry has one mirror with a stale TLS chain — I'll rotate the cert tonight. Might add ~30m to total sync time.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: scheduled for 2026-03-19T16:00Z if all prechecks pass

lina: Great — keeping this thread for async updates. If anyone needs a quick sync call, throw a time and I can join for the cutover pre-check at 08:00 PT tomorrow.
